items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm trying to think about it now. Maybe Eddie knows you. Who's that? I don't think so. This is an Orie's band. [INTERVIEWEE] He doesn't kill Orie's. Might be a little before you're at town. Before my time.

ctx.x: Well I didn't know him. I knew Dude. He used to play with Joe Avery until I'm up at Dallas. Come in. How you feel?
Oh hello Eddie. Eddie Summers coming in. What's it? What's it? How's it going? Well we don't want to keep you longer anyway. I think we covered those pictures pretty good I believe.

Yeah. I think this guy named him. I'm a noble one. They used to, nicknames called him Rabbit. Everybody. Oh that's Rabbit. That's Rabbit. Oh the bass drummer. Oh good. That's Rabbit. That's Rabbit. And who was the violin player?
